title: feat(openapi): emit per-procedure error shapes
body:
## 🎯 Changes

Stacked on #7591, which adds `.errors()` to the procedure builder. This layer adds support to `@trpc/openapi` to emit those per-procedure shapes on a per-endpoint basis.

Today every operation points its `default` response at a single shared `#/components/responses/Error` built from the router-wide `errorFormatter`. A procedure that declares its own shapes with `.errors()` now gets an **inline** `default` response holding the union of everything it can return. Procedures on the router-wide shape keep the `$ref`.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **New Features**
  - OpenAPI documents now represent procedure-specific error responses, including unions of shared and custom error variants.
  - Generated client types expose accurate error shapes for each procedure, including specialized cases such as rate-limit errors.
  - Procedures without custom errors continue using the shared error response.

- **Documentation**
  - Added guidance and examples explaining shared versus procedure-specific OpenAPI error responses.
